language.title: Translation Language
language.description: Set target languages for translation. The system auto-detects source language and chooses the appropriate target.
language.howItWorksDesc: Translates to "Primary Language" by default; when source is detected as "Primary Language", translates to "Secondary Language".
language.secondaryLanguageHint: Used when source is the primary language

hotkey.title: Hotkey Configuration
hotkey.doubleCopyDescMac: Press Cmd+C twice quickly to trigger translation, window appears near cursor
hotkey.doubleCopyDescWin: Press Ctrl+C twice quickly to trigger translation (first press copies selection), window appears near cursor
hotkey.altSpaceDescMac: Press Option+Space to show translation window at screen center
hotkey.altSpaceDescWin: Press Alt+Space to show translation window at screen center

permissions.title: Permission Helper
permissions.description: Follow these steps to grant macOS permissions.
permissions.macOnlyDesc: Open this helper on a Mac to complete authorization.

step1.title: Open Privacy & Security - Accessibility
step1.desc: Click the button to jump directly to the Accessibility permission panel.
step1.note: If nothing pops up, open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility manually.

step2.title: Fallback: Reveal the app in Finder
step2.desc: If drag fails, reveal the .app in Finder, then drag it into the permission window.
step2.note: Drag the .app into the system permission window list to grant access.
step2.unavailable: App path unavailable. Try opening Finder manually.

permissions.openedSettings: Opened the system permission window. Follow the steps if not authorized.
